programme.title: Mr. India

programme.title: Pure Bollywood

programme.title: Tumbbad
programme.desc: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

programme.title: Baazigar
programme.desc: A ruthless killer seeking revenge seduces a businessman's elder daughter, stages her murder as suicide, then sets out to destroy the rest of her family.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Desperate for a major career breakthrough, private investigator Raj accepts a hostage recovery mission, only to stumble straight into the center of a massive political plot.

programme.title: Don 2
programme.desc: After ruling the Asian underworld, Don targets Europe's criminal scene. Trapped between the Berlin mafia and relentless law enforcement, he fights to survive betrayal.

programme.title: Karan Arjun
programme.desc: Durga's sons, Karan and Arjun, set out to avenge their father's death but are killed by their cruel uncle. Years later, they are reincarnated to deliver justice.

programme.title: Jawan
programme.desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

programme.title: Army
programme.desc: After army officer Arjun is brutally killed by gangster Naagraj, his wife Geeta vows revenge and forms a group of determined young men to bring Naagraj down.

programme.title: Commando - A One Man Army
programme.desc: Karan, an Indian commando, is arrested by Chinese officials after a crash. Accused of spying, he must escape from their tough prison camp using all his skills.

programme.title: Sniff
programme.desc: Sunny Gill, born without smell, gains superpowers after a lab accident enhances his senses. He transforms into a superhero, discovering strength and purpose in his new identity.

programme.title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
programme.desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.

programme.title: Barsaat (1995)
programme.desc: Badal likes his classmate Tina, but her father disapproves. The father falsely gets him arrested, trying to end their relationship before it goes any further.

programme.title: Daulat Ki Jung
programme.desc: Rajesh and Asha elope because their rival business families oppose their love. However, they become entangled with two rival groups searching for a hidden tribal treasure.

programme.title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
programme.desc: Arjun and Pyare, two cops from the same station, are wrongly accused of multiple crimes. Their probe reveals the real offenders are their own lookalike impostors.

programme.title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
programme.desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

programme.title: Kick
programme.desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

programme.title: Tigers : Can A Salesman Be A Hero
programme.desc: A pharma salesman in Pakistan takes on his own company after discovering they knowingly marketed harmful baby formula, risking everything to expose the truth.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns
programme.desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.

programme.title: Kanyadaan
programme.desc: Married as children, Rekha and Amar are separated by fate. Years later, shocking truths emerge as Rekha discovers Amar's new marriage and Kumar's hidden identity.

programme.title: Andaz Apna Apna
programme.desc: Amar and Prem are broke dreamers chasing the same rich heiress, Raveena, but their silly feud gets wildly out of hand after crossing paths with dangerous gangster Teja.

programme.title: Ram Lakhan
programme.desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

programme.title: Biwi No. 1
programme.desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

programme.title: Khalnayak
programme.desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

programme.title: Mass Jathara
programme.desc: An honest railway cop is transferred to a small town. He fights to bring down a smuggling network run by a powerful drug lord.

programme.title: Dream Girl
programme.desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

programme.title: Sajan Chale Sasural
programme.desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
programme.desc: In an arranged marriage, failed cricketer Mahendra and doctor Mahima bond over their shared nickname, Mahi, and their love for cricket, inspiring her to pursue her dreams.

programme.title: Coolie No. 1 (2020)
programme.desc: When a matchmaker is insulted by Jeffrey Rozario, a rich businessman, he vows to exact revenge. As a result, he makes a porter pretend to be a rich man and marries him off to Rozario's daughter.

programme.title: Coolie No. 1 (1995)
programme.desc: A matchmaker plots to humble arrogant rich man Hoshiyar Chand by having Raju, a coolie, pose as a millionaire, leading to hilarious chaos as Raju tries to win his daughter's hand.

programme.title: Dhadkan
